# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, the `main` branch (version 3.x) of SEOSONA OS is actively supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 3.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 2.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.x.x   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within SEOSONA OS, please do not disclose it publicly. Instead, please open a private GitHub issue or contact the repository owner directly. 

We take all security issues seriously and will respond promptly to investigate and resolve the problem.
